s='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Trace the bouncing ray: it advances until an 8 wall, then turns
    # alongside the wall toward an opening and continues through it.
    r,c=next((i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==2)
    out[r][c]=2
    # For these striped-maze puzzles, trace the alternating horizontal/vertical
    # runs through the apertures in each successive barrier.
    direction=(1,0)
    seen=set()
    for _ in range(h*w*4):
        dr,dc=direction; nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
        if not (0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w): break
        if grid[nr][nc]!=8:
            r,c=nr,nc; out[r][c]=2; continue
        # Turn along the face of the encountered barrier; choose the opening
        # nearest the current coordinate on that barrier.
        if dr:
            choices=[j for j in range(w) if grid[nr][j]==0]
            if not choices: break
            nc=min(choices,key=lambda j:abs(j-c))
            direction=(0, 1 if nc>=c else -1)
            # follow along the prior row to the aperture, then step through
            continue
        else:
            choices=[i for i in range(h) if grid[i][nc]==0]
            if not choices: break
            nr=min(choices,key=lambda i:abs(i-r))
            direction=(1 if nr>=r else -1,0)
            continue
        if (r,c,direction) in seen: break
